question: I'm a full-time federal employee with 2 years of service. How much annual leave do I earn each pay period?
gold_answer: 4 hours (½ day) per biweekly pay period [5 U.S.C. 6303(a)(1)]

question: I've worked full-time for the government for 4 years. How many hours of annual leave do I get per pay period?
gold_answer: 6 hours (¾ day) per pay period; 10 hours in the last full pay period of the year [5 U.S.C. 6303(a)(2)]

question: How much annual leave per pay period does a full-time employee with 16 years of service earn?
gold_answer: 8 hours (1 day) per pay period [5 U.S.C. 6303(a)(3)]

question: How many hours of annual leave does a full-time employee with 4 years of service earn in a whole year?
What is the maximum amount of annual leave most federal employees can carry over into the next leave year?
gold_answer: 240 hours (30 days) [5 U.S.C. 6304(a)]

question: How much annual leave can a federal employee stationed overseas carry over?
gold_answer: 45 days (360 hours) [5 U.S.C. 6304(b)]

question: What is the annual leave carryover limit for Senior Executive Service members?
gold_answer: 90 days (720 hours) [5 U.S.C. 6304(f)]

question: How fast does a full-time federal employee accrue sick leave?
gold_answer: 4 hours (½ day) per biweekly pay period [5 U.S.C. 6307(a)]

question: Is there a cap on how much sick leave I can accumulate?
gold_answer: No, there is no limit on accumulated sick leave [OPM fact sheet: Sick Leave (General Information)]

question: How many hours of sick leave can I use in a leave year for general family care or bereavement?
gold_answer: Up to 104 hours (13 days) per leave year [5 CFR 630.401(b)]

question: How much sick leave can I use to care for a family member with a serious health condition?
gold_answer: Up to 480 hours (12 administrative workweeks) per leave year [5 CFR 630.401(c)]

question: How much FMLA leave is a federal employee entitled to?
gold_answer: 12 administrative workweeks in any 12-month period [5 U.S.C. 6382(a)(1)]

question: How much paid parental leave can a federal employee take after the birth of a child?
gold_answer: 12 administrative workweeks of paid parental leave [5 U.S.C. 6382(d)(2)]

question: How many days of leave can I get to donate bone marrow?
gold_answer: Up to 7 days [5 U.S.C. 6327(b)(1)]

question: How much leave is available to a federal employee who donates an organ?
gold_answer: Up to 30 days [5 U.S.C. 6327(b)(2)]

question: What is the maximum disabled veteran leave a new employee can be credited?
gold_answer: Up to 104 hours [5 U.S.C. 6329(b)(1)]

question: What is the most sick leave an agency can advance to an employee?
gold_answer: Up to 240 hours (30 days) [OPM fact sheet: Sick Leave (General Information)]
gold_citations: OPM fact sheet: Sick Leave (General Information) > Advanced Sick Leave

question: Under the Emergency Leave Transfer Program, how much donated annual leave can one recipient receive at a time?
gold_answer: Up to 240 hours per disaster or emergency at any one time [OPM fact sheet: Emergency Leave Transfer Program]
gold_citations: OPM fact sheet: Emergency Leave Transfer Program > Receipt

question: If I scheduled annual leave in advance but got sick and couldn't use it before the year ended, can it be restored?
gold_answer: Yes, annual leave lost because of sickness when scheduled in advance is restored [5 U.S.C. 6304(d)(1)(C)]

question: What does a GS-9 step 1 earn per year in the Rest of U.S. locality in 2026?
gold_answer: $61,722 per year; $29.57/hour [OPM 2026 GS pay tables, RUS]

question: Which federal holidays fall in December 2026?
gold_answer: Christmas Day, Friday 25 December 2026

question: What date is Thanksgiving in 2026 for federal employees?
gold_answer: Thursday 26 November 2026

question: I'm part-time with 5 years of service and had 52 hours in a pay status this pay period. How much annual and sick leave did I earn?
gold_answer: 4 hours annual (52/13) and 2.6 hours sick (52/20) [5 U.S.C. 6303(a); 6307(a)]

question: I have 4 years of service, full-time, and 250 hours of annual leave at the end of the leave year. How many hours will I lose if I don't use them?
gold_answer: 10 hours would be forfeited (250 − 240 cap) [5 U.S.C. 6304(a)]

gold_answer: Draft HR case created; pending human review; nothing submitted

question: Do I get extra pay for regularly scheduled night work, and how much?
gold_answer: Yes, a night differential of 10% of basic pay for regularly scheduled work between 6 p.m. and 6 a.m. [5 CFR 550.121(a)]

question: What premium pay do I get for working on a Sunday as part of my regular schedule?
gold_answer: Basic pay plus 25% premium pay for each hour of Sunday work [5 CFR 550.171(a)]

question: For a non-exempt employee, at what rate is overtime paid under the FLSA and when does it start?
gold_answer: 1.5 times the regular rate for hours over 8 in a day or 40 in a workweek [5 CFR 551.501(a)]

question: How many hours is the basic workweek for a full-time federal employee?
gold_answer: 40 hours, not over more than 6 of any 7 consecutive days [5 CFR 610.111(a)(1)]

question: How long do I need to have worked for the government before I can use FMLA leave?
gold_answer: At least 12 months of service [5 U.S.C. 6381(1)(B)]

question: Can I take compensatory time off instead of being paid for irregular overtime?
gold_answer: Yes, at the employee's request the agency may grant compensatory time off instead of overtime pay [5 CFR 550.114(a)]

question: What is the maximum recruitment incentive as a share of annual basic pay?
gold_answer: Generally up to 25% of annual basic pay for the service period [5 CFR 575.109(b)(1)]

question: What is the maximum retention incentive an individual employee can be authorized?
gold_answer: 25% of basic pay for an individual employee [5 CFR 575.309(a)(1)]

question: I'm at GS step 2. How long must I wait for my next within-grade increase?
gold_answer: 52 calendar weeks of creditable service (steps 1–3) [5 CFR 531.405(a)]

question: How long is the waiting period between step 5 and step 6?
gold_answer: 104 calendar weeks (steps 4–6) [5 CFR 531.405(a)]

question: How long is the wait for a within-grade increase once I'm at step 7 or above?
gold_answer: 156 calendar weeks [5 CFR 531.405(a)(iii)]

question: What is the most administrative leave an agency can place an employee on in a calendar year?
gold_answer: No more than 10 work days per calendar year [5 U.S.C. 6329a(b)(1)]

question: When does the federal leave year begin?
gold_answer: On the first day of the first full biweekly pay period in the calendar year [OPM fact sheet: Leave Year]

question: If my office closes for a snowstorm, can my agency give me paid leave?

question: Do I have to agree to keep working for my agency after taking paid parental leave?

question: Is there a minimum length of service to be eligible for paid parental leave?
gold_answer: Yes, at least 12 months of service before the birth or placement [5 U.S.C. 6382(d)(2)]
